channel.title: Cheap Justice of India
channel.description: Real facts about India's judiciary — delivered with satirical honesty.

item.title: The Revolving Door of Justice: From Bench to Political Bench
item.description: A look at how retired judges seamlessly transition into political roles, raising serious questions about their impartiality while they were on the bench.

item.title: Sealed Cover Jurisprudence: Justice in the Dark
item.description: How the practice of sealed cover submissions has become a tool to keep the public in the dark about matters that directly affect them.
